That means a bare `tsc --noEmit` here type-checks an EMPTY program and exits 0 no matter how broken the tree is — `--noEmit` does not follow `references`, only `--build` does (#3805). Use `npm run typecheck` (`tsc -b --noEmit`), which is byte-for-byte what prek's `tsc` hook and _validate.yml's `Typecheck (tsc -b)` step run, so a local green predicts the gate. Every project must stay referenced from here: `tsc -b` is the only typecheck any gate runs, so a project outside this list is a project nothing checks (see the notes in tsconfig.e2e.json and tsconfig.wdio.json).
